title: A novel MAMLD1 variant in a newborn with hypospadias and elevated 17-hydroxyprogesterone.
authors: Wang, Juanjuan; Sun, Yafeng; Deng, Qian; Wang, Xin; Cai, Wenjuan; Chen, Yuqing
one_liner_zh: 该文报道新生儿尿道下裂中MAMLD1新变异的临床遗传学与功能实验，虽含分子动力学模拟，但核心是疾病诊断而非TF-DNA互作建模，与本课题关联弱。
abstract: PURPOSE: Disorders of sex development (DSD) have complex pathogenesis, and evidence suggests an association between MAMLD1 defects and DSD. MAMLD1 is expressed in gonadal tissues and affected males exhibit hypospadias, steroid hormone abnormalities, or gonadal underdevelopment. We performed genetic testing on a newborn patient with severe hypospadias and an elevation of 17-hydroxyprogesterone (17alpha-OH) for the diagnosis of DSD. METHODS: Genetic testing of the proband and parents was conducted using whole-exome and Sanger sequencing. The identified variant was transfected into HEK293T cells to assess mutant protein expression using western blot (WB) and into steroidogenic NCI-H295R cells to assess MAMLD1 and CYP17A1 transcript levels using qPCR. Molecular dynamics simulations were performed to construct a structural model and analyze potential biological implications. RESULTS: A novel heterozygous variant was identified in the proband's MAMLD1, NM_005491.5: c.1619_1637del (p.Gln540Alafs*72), inherited from the mother. In transfected cells, the wild-type and mutant proteins were 86.2 and 68.3 kDa, respectively, indicating the formation of a truncated protein. While MAMLD1 transcription was not affected, CYP17A1 transcription levels decreased with the variant compared to wild-type, suggesting an impact on the transactivation of CYP17A1. The truncated protein exhibited enhanced hydrophobicity, owing to the absence of the C-terminal structural portion, resulting in a looser protein structure. CONCLUSION: Severe hypospadias in the proband may be attributed to a novel MAMLD1 variant, whereas the 17alpha-OH elevation might be related to interference with CYP17A1 transcriptional activation. This study expands the spectrum of MAMLD1 variants and underscores the critical role of genetic testing in the diagnosis of DSD.
abstract_zh: 目的：性发育异常（DSD）发病机制复杂，有证据表明MAMLD1缺陷与DSD相关。MAMLD1在性腺组织中表达，受影响的男性表现为尿道下裂、类固醇激素异常或性腺发育不全。我们对一名患有严重尿道下裂且17-羟孕酮（17alpha-OH）升高的新生儿患者进行了基因检测，以诊断DSD。方法：对先证者及其父母进行全外显子组和Sanger测序。将鉴定出的变异转染至HEK293T细胞，通过蛋白质印迹（WB）评估突变蛋白表达；转染至类固醇生成NCI-H295R细胞，通过qPCR评估MAMLD1和CYP17A1转录水平。进行分子动力学模拟以构建结构模型并分析潜在生物学意义。结果：在先证者的MAMLD1中鉴定出一个新的杂合变异，NM_005491.5：c.1619_1637del（p.Gln540Alafs*72），遗传自母亲。在转染细胞中，野生型和突变蛋白分别为86.2和68.3 kDa，表明形成了截短蛋白。虽然MAMLD1转录未受影响，但与野生型相比，该变异导致CYP17A1转录水平下降，提示其对CYP17A1的反式激活有影响。截短蛋白因缺乏C端结构部分而表现出增强的疏水性，导致蛋白结构更松散。结论：先证者的严重尿道下裂可能归因于一个新的MAMLD1变异，而17alpha-OH升高可能与干扰CYP17A1转录激活有关。本研究扩展了MAMLD1变异谱，并强调了基因检测在DSD诊断中的关键作用。
